purpose: Visual check S1 (09.11.2026): one identical scene in 3-4 candidate looks so Marcel can choose the base style (concept: low-poly 3D, toon shader, outlines; style changes with the era; voxel as alternative).
scene: A small calm island seen from an isometric bird's-eye view: a sandy beach, a green meadow, a small forest, a clear stream running from a spring into the sea, a few grey rocks, fruit trees and berry bushes. Two stylized human inhabitants, a man and a woman in simple clothes, stand on the beach a few steps apart and look around curiously. Soft morning light, peaceful and friendly mood. No text, no letters, no watermark.

variants.label_de: Low-Poly mit Toon-Shader und Konturen (Grundlook laut Konzept)
variants.style: Stylized low-poly 3D game art with flat-shaded facets, toon shading and clean dark outlines, bright friendly colour palette.

Voxel art 3D game style, everything built from small cubes, soft ambient occlusion, clean pastel colours.
